editorial:
Imagine being a pro at breaking people during interrogations, only to find out your own parents were murdered by a brutal gang. That is the nightmare Jimmy Vickers is dealing with here. You get to follow him as he goes on a dark, angry mission to hunt down every single person responsible for his family's death. It feels like a high-stakes game of cat and mouse, but Jimmy is both the cat and the mouse. While he is hunting killers, the cops and his own old special ops team are hunting him. The vibe is gritty and tense, making you feel the pressure as he runs out of time and places to hide.

The action hits hard and the pacing keeps you on your toes, though some parts feel a bit repetitive. You will appreciate how the movie shows the brutal side of revenge without getting too bogged down in slow dialogue. If you love stories about one man against the world, you should definitely check this out.
endingExplained: After a series of brutal fights, Jimmy finally tracks down the leader of the gang. He uses all his interrogation skills to make the boss suffer before killing him. Even though the police and his old unit almost catch him, he manages to finish his list of targets. He gets his revenge, but he is left as a broken man with nothing left. He disappears into the shadows, finally at peace but completely alone.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves revenge stories and special ops action.
